questions.question: GST was implemented in India on:
questions.explanation: GST came into effect on 1 July 2017.

questions.question: The ancient university of Nalanda was located in present-day:
questions.explanation: Nalanda is in present-day Bihar.

questions.question: The term "GDP" stands for:
questions.explanation: GDP = Gross Domestic Product.

questions.question: Which is the smallest continent by area?
questions.explanation: Australia is the smallest continent.

questions.question: Which is the largest planet in the solar system?
questions.explanation: Jupiter is the largest planet.

questions.question: A money bill can be introduced only in the:
questions.explanation: A money bill can be introduced only in the Lok Sabha.

questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution guarantees the Right to Constitutional Remedies?
questions.explanation: Article 32 is called the "heart and soul" of the Constitution.

questions.question: Light travels fastest in:
questions.explanation: Light travels fastest in a vacuum (~3×10⁸ m/s).

questions.question: The study of living organisms is called:
questions.explanation: Biology is the study of life and living organisms.

questions.question: NITI Aayog replaced which earlier body?
questions.explanation: NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission in 2015.

questions.question: How many players are there in a cricket team on the field?

questions.question: The Ranji Trophy is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Ranji Trophy is a domestic first-class cricket competition.

questions.explanation: Gandhi gave "Do or Die" during the Quit India Movement.

questions.question: Which tax was subsumed under GST?

questions.question: The Param Vir Chakra is awarded for:
questions.explanation: The Param Vir Chakra is India’s highest wartime gallantry award.

questions.question: Which blood group is known as the universal donor?
questions.explanation: O-negative is the universal donor blood group.

questions.question: What is the chemical formula of common salt?
questions.explanation: Common salt is sodium chloride, NaCl.

questions.question: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.explanation: Mercury is the planet closest to the Sun.

questions.question: The Thar Desert is located mainly in which state?
questions.explanation: The Thar Desert lies mostly in Rajasthan.

questions.question: Who gave the slogan "Give me blood and I will give you freedom"?
questions.explanation: The slogan is associated with Subhash Chandra Bose.

questions.question: Where is the headquarters of the Reserve Bank of India?
questions.explanation: The RBI is headquartered in Mumbai.

questions.question: The Sun rises in the:
questions.explanation: Due to Earth’s west-to-east rotation, the Sun appears to rise in the east.

questions.question: Which part of the plant conducts photosynthesis using the green pigment?
questions.explanation: Chlorophyll is the green pigment that captures light energy.

questions.question: The unit of electrical resistance is the:
questions.explanation: Electrical resistance is measured in ohms.

questions.question: Who composed the song "Vande Mataram"?
questions.explanation: Bankim Chandra Chatterjee wrote "Vande Mataram".

questions.question: Which festival is known as the "Festival of Lights"?
questions.explanation: Diwali is the Festival of Lights.

questions.question: The capital of British India was shifted from Calcutta to Delhi in:
questions.explanation: The capital was shifted to Delhi in 1911.

questions.question: How many bones are there in the adult human body?
questions.explanation: An adult human has 206 bones.

questions.explanation: India’s financial year is April to March.

questions.explanation: Wular Lake in Jammu & Kashmir is the largest freshwater lake in India.

questions.explanation: The Indian peacock is the national bird.

questions.explanation: Mount Everest lies on the Nepal–China border, with its peak in Nepal.

questions.question: Which is the highest civilian award in India?
questions.explanation: The Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian award.

questions.question: Which organ in the human body purifies blood?
questions.explanation: The kidneys filter and purify blood.

questions.explanation: Transpiration is the loss of water vapour from leaves.

questions.explanation: Mars looks red due to iron oxide on its surface.

questions.question: Water boils at what temperature at sea level?
questions.explanation: Water boils at 100°C at standard sea-level pressure.

questions.question: The President of India is elected by:
questions.explanation: The President is elected by an electoral college of MPs and MLAs.

questions.question: The "Gateway of India" is located in which city?
questions.explanation: The Gateway of India is in Mumbai.

questions.question: Which element is essential for the formation of haemoglobin?
questions.explanation: Iron is essential for haemoglobin formation.
